title: team-process session record
description: Durable run ledger for one team-process session. Each concurrent run owns a directory .team-process/sessions/<id>/ (id = sanitized team name) holding this session.json plus inbox/ + outbox/ for typed-form messages. The EXISTENCE of any sessions/<id>/session.json = team mode active. Written initial-minimal by an explicit Invoke-TeamModeGuard.ps1 -SetMarker from /feature-team (TeamCreate/TeamDelete were removed from Claude Code, so the lifecycle is not hook-driven); enriched by the orchestrator as the run proceeds (roster, phase, ledger). Read on SessionStart to resume + remind. 'workflow' classifies how to resume (feature-team vs freeform). Most fields optional so the minimal -SetMarker record validates.

id.description: Session id = the record's filename stem; sanitized team name ([A-Za-z0-9._-]).

workflow.description: Which workflow produced this session — drives how resume continues.

team.description: Run/team name set at -SetMarker; <id> is its sanitized form. Members run as background Agents and no longer require team_name (it remains an optional back-compat member discriminator).

claudeSessionId.description: Claude Code session_id that owns / last attached to this run. Captured at -SetMarker, refreshed on resume (re-run). The unique key for correlating the run to the current Claude session — disambiguates the statusline's current run when several share a branch, and re-links a `--resume`d conversation to its run.

branch.description: Git branch the run targets. Heuristic current-run key when claudeSessionId is unavailable; not unique when several runs share a branch.

summary.description: Short human description of what this team is doing — the issue title or a one-sentence feature essence. Shown in the statusline + resume reminder so a glance answers 'what is this run'.

task.description: Freeform: the scheduled-task description. Omitted for feature-team (its spec is the issue).

phase.description: Resume cursor. feature-team uses the process.md phase enum; freeform uses any non-empty string.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last ledger update.

roster.description: Spawned members, their lanes, and per-member resume state. Source of truth for run/lane (projected via -SyncLane).

task.description: Short imperative description of this member's task (mirrors the BRIEF task). Shown next to the role in the statusline.

progress.description: Last-known progress note for resume re-dispatch (free text). Lets the lead re-spawn a same-name member with its prior context: BRIEF (from inbox) + this progress + relevant decisions.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria restated from the owning spec at intake — the locked contract + regression gate. Surfaced on resume and published in the issue decision record.

decisions.description: Crucial decisions and facts captured AS THEY ARE MADE (chat confirmation, an answered question, a resolved FINDING, a member's RESULT.notes). Survives compaction; the resume reminder surfaces these and they OVERRIDE a conflicting summary. Published to the owning issue at ship as a Markdown projection.

id.description: Stable 1-based ordinal within the run; never reused.

decision.description: The decision or crucial fact, one line.

why.description: Rationale — why this over the alternative.

supersedes.description: What this overrides (the issue text, an earlier decision, a spec line). The field that stops an agreed decision from being silently re-lost after compaction.

refs.description: Artifact pointers (paths, SHAs, spec anchors) — the source of truth the decision rests on.

ledger.description: One entry per wave: what changed / was decided / was deferred.

allOf.description: feature-team sessions follow the process.md phase vocabulary; freeform sessions may use any non-empty phase string.
